title: fix(runtime): six door strings say "this system" or drop the noun, not "this environment" (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Fixes #24327

Clause-②: no
Basis: copy only. Every HTTP status, error code and response shape is unchanged; only the human-readable text moves.

## What changed

Ten user-facing strings in `packages/runtime/src/domains/` now follow objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as the triage comment 6250167038 reads each one: inside the running system, a string names the system the caller is in as "this system", or drops the noun.

| Site | Sense (triage) | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `permission-set-clone.ts` `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_NOTICE` (the clone door's 200 `notice`) | made here, not from a package | "The copy is a new permission set authored in this environment, with no link …" | "The copy is a new permission set authored in this system, with no link …" |
| `mcp.ts` `handleMcpRequest` (404 when `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false`) | the system the caller is in | "MCP server is not enabled for this environment" | "MCP server is not enabled" |
| `mcp.ts` `handleMcpSkillRequest` (same 404) | the system the caller is in | same | same |
| `share-links.ts` (501, no share-link service) | the system the caller is in | "Sharing is not configured for this environment" | "Sharing is not configured" |
| `webhooks.ts` (501, no webhooks service) | the system the caller is in | "… no webhooks service is registered for this environment. …" | "… no webhooks service is registered. …" |
| `webhooks.ts` (501, no `handleRedeliver` member) | the system the caller is in | "… the webhooks service registered for this environment does not implement handleRedeliver." | "… the registered webhooks service does not implement handleRedeliver." |
| `approvals.ts` (501, no approvals service) | the system the caller is in | "Approval action pages are not available: no approvals service is registered for this environment. …" | "… no approvals service is registered. …" |
| `approvals.ts` (501, no `handleActionPage` member) | the system the caller is in | "… the approvals service registered for this environment does not implement handleActionPage." | "… the registered approvals service does not implement handleActionPage." |
| `automation-hooks.ts` (501, no trigger-api service) | the system the caller is in | "Inbound automation hooks are not available: no trigger-api service is registered for this environment. …" | "… no trigger-api service is registered. …" |
| `automation-hooks.ts` (501, no `handleInboundHook` member) | the system the caller is in | "… the trigger-api service registered for this environment does not implement handleInboundHook." | "… the registered trigger-api service does not implement handleInboundHook." |

- The four `approvals.ts` / `automation-hooks.ts` strings were added in patch round 1. Each splits the phrase across a string concatenation (`… for this '` + `'environment …`), so a one-line `git grep 'this environment'` never saw them.
- `share-links.ts:173-174`: a code comment quoted the old 501 text verbatim. Only the quote changes.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json`, MCP item, first acceptance clause: it quoted the old 404 body, and since ADR-0138 D2 its "404 … on BOTH" no longer held for an anonymous `/mcp` caller. The clause now quotes the new text and names the caller. With the switch off, `/mcp/skill` answers 404 to any caller, because the skill is public (`http-dispatcher.mcp.test.ts` "404s when the MCP surface is opted out", anonymous on purpose). `/mcp` answers 404 to a signed-in or system caller. An anonymous `/mcp` caller is refused `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` before the switch is read (`http-dispatcher.mcp.test.ts` "anonymous → 401 UNAUTHENTICATED with the switch off, not 404"). Only that clause moves.
- `.changeset/24327-runtime-this-system-copy.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime`.

## Readers of the changed strings, measured

`git grep` over the whole tree (packages, content/docs, docs/qa, skills, examples, .changeset) for each string and its fragments:

- `permission-set-clone.test.ts` asserts against the exported `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_NOTICE` constant, never a restated copy, so it moves with the source.
- `webhooks-redeliver.test.ts:162` and `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-webhooks-redeliver.conformance.test.ts:327` pin status and code (`501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`) plus the substrings "no webhooks service is registered" and "does not implement handleRedeliver". Both survive the change.
- `approvals-act.test.ts:204`/`:212` ("no approvals service is registered", "does not implement handleActionPage") and `automation-hooks.test.ts:284`/`:292` ("no trigger-api service is registered", "does not implement handleInboundHook") pin status and code plus substrings that survive the change.
- No test pins the MCP 404 or the share-link 501 prose. The MCP 404's status and code are pinned by `http-dispatcher.mcp.test.ts` and `mcp-anonymous-first.hono.integration.test.ts` (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), unchanged.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx:369` and `:422` are prose about the concept, not quotes of the notice. Left unchanged.
- `CHANGELOG.md` entries that quote the old share-link 501 are release-owned history. Left unchanged.
- No i18n catalog or error-message map carries a localized copy of any of these strings.
- No consumer parses the text. The console shows the clone notice verbatim.

## Left alone, and why

- `mcp.ts` about `:513` ("an MCP client listing prompts on this request sees fewer than this environment declares"): a `logger.warn` operator log inside `warnIfSkillListIncomplete`, not a response body or a client-visible warning.
- `automation-hooks.ts:128`, the rest of the no-service 501 ("… compose it on the environment that owns the flow."): this names which deployment to compose the trigger on, a configuration scope, not the system the caller is in. The noun the round asked for ("registered for this environment") is dropped.
- The six `domain:engine` strings in `objectql`, `metadata-protocol` and `platform-objects` belong to #24360 and are not touched here.

## Verification

Patch round 1, head `89e99ce2a` (on `f4b2a3f78`, which merged `origin/main` `83dfbc046`). All builds and tests went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`: "27 file(s) / 190 error(s) / 68 pinned signature(s) held").

A verbose re-run of `approvals-act` + `automation-hooks` shows their 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED cases green ("Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 32 passed (32)").
- `@objectstack/http-conformance` `hono-webhooks-redeliver` and `hono-mcp-anonymous-first`: "Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 19 passed (19)".
- From the first round: the full runtime `local` project on `2b3424833`: "Test Files 419 passed (419) · Tests 6606 passed | 19 skipped (6625)". `test:repo` is not run locally (CI's `Test Core`).

Gates (union run after the final commit, head `89e99ce2a`; each exit code captured before any pipe):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 63 commands. All 63 exited 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included ("111 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load"). `--ran` reconciliation: "Run reconciliation — 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN."

(`check:meta-type-normalized` scans `packages/rest/src` only, so it does not cover these paths.)
- Artifact-roster families whose roster sits under a changed directory, all exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census`. Platform-checklist families: `check:platform-checklist` ("OK — 16 areas, 327 items") and `check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs`, both exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the six changed `.ts` files: exit 0, no output.

No ablation: the change is copy, and per the triage the prose is not pinned.

## Acceptance notes

- The census correction from round 1 is filed as #24368: 68 non-comment lines, not about 122 comments, and the strings outside `runtime/src/domains` and #24360. It also covers objectui's restated clone notice and console MCP strings.
